abstract: _early holocene ice retreat pattern of the laurentide le sheet in the laurentales deiatel man connu. a e'est, la moraine maris-batiscan constitue la seule position frontale continue identifiee entre la moraine de saint-narcisse et la moraine de sakami_, comme la ceinture morainique de cartier 1, en ontario, la moraine maris-batiscan est montau de saint-narcisse a la la flui pisticoene. le territiore a l'etude est un transect, du saint-nature au temsicamique, qui fait la fonction entre la moraine maris-batiscan et la peistocene. the study area is a transect between the riviere saint-maurice and the temsicamique area, roughly in the axis of the mars-batiscan and carrier morines. the application pattern of this transect is based on a systematic mapping of glacial landforms by air photography analysis at a scale of 1:15 840, verified by fieldwork. the glacial margin is bent east of the transect, it becomes relatively linear westward with a wsw-ene general orientation and several minor locations and re-entrants. the glacial margin was mainly controlled by topography. depalcation between the latitudinal margins of the transect occurred over a period of 600 years, approximately between 11.46 and 10,86 cal ka (10 000 and 9580 as c bp). an acceleration of the ice retreat rate occurred after the mars-batiscan moraine phase, followed by relatively stable rates of retreat. the new isochrones improve the previous models of demgication de la region mattawan-temsicamique, puisqu'il montre un front de deglaciation lineaire et sans rentrant notable with no visible re-entrant in the axis of the ottawa river-temsicamique area during the studied time span._ 2003577892049692003578920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496920496204920496204920496920492049692049692049204969204
